messages:
alex: Hey @jin (Coaxia) — want to sync on a quick kernel-probe for perf/W vs throughput on your A1 boards. Can we run a joint smokecheck next week?

jin (Coaxia): Hi Alex, yes we can. Which telemetry do you need? package power + per-GPU counters sufficient or do you need trace-level metrics?

sam: Package power, per-socket, NVML GPU power, hwmon rails, and process-level CPU/GPU time. Also tokens/s at seq len 256 and 1024. Short runs first (5m) then steady-state (5–10m).

alex: Exact metrics: steady-state throughput (tokens/s), tail latency p95/p99, avg watt, and derived perf/W (tokens/s ÷ watts). Baseline target for us is ~2.5k tokens/s @ ~60W on A1-nominal for the 3B model — we'll treat that as reference.

jia: Please also capture kernel build flags, glibc, and the kernel patches (if any). We need firmware + BIOS versions to reproduce.

jin (Coaxia): I can expose BIOS knobs and provide fw versions. Do you prefer us to run with stock BIOS or your tuned profile?

alex: Start with stock BIOS for one pass, then apply your tuned profile as a second pass. That helps isolate kernel vs config wins.

alex: Run commands we'll use:
```
# run-smoke.sh
export MODEL=redwood-3b-quant
export SEQ_LEN=256
./bench --model $MODEL --batch 1 --seq $SEQ_LEN --duration 300 --out perf_seq256.csv
./bench --model $MODEL --batch 16 --seq 1024 --duration 300 --out perf_seq1024.csv
# collect NVML/hwmon/IPMI in parallel
./collect-telemetry --nvml --hwmon --ipmi --out meta_logs.tar.gz
```

bench-bot: CI job created: https://ci.redwood.ai/bench/2473 — job will collect nvml, ipmi, hwmon and attach system profile.

leo: Note: pin CUDA/cuDNN/kernels and disable runtime autotune for both runs so results are comparable across partners. Also pin CPU affinity and isolate IRQs.

anna: I'll reserve a marketplace compatibility row and draft a short blurb for PR once we have validated numbers. One ask: make sure power timestamps align to token output so we can compute perf/W time-series.

jin (Coaxia): Sounds good. I can run Tue or Thu next week. We'll share raw telemetry, bios dump, and kernel config. Confirm: you want both stock and tuned BIOS, and CPU affinity pinned?

alex: Correct — stock then tuned, CPU affinity pinned, IRQ isolation. Please tag outputs with run_id=2473214567-coaxia so bench-bot can pick them up.

sam: I'll stage the canary in our sandbox to validate the run script and ensure no regressions in the model runtime. If anything flakey appears we'll abort and debug with you.

jia: I'll prepare a short checklist for kernel flags and compiler options (O3, link-time opt, O0 for debug builds if needed) and put it in the repo.

alex: Action items: Jin — run stock + tuned Tue; share telemetry + BIOS + kernel config; Sam — validate scripts and run canary; Jia — collect kernel/build flags; Anna — draft marketplace note; Leo — confirm autotune off + affinity. :thumbsup:

sam: I'll also diff perf.csv across runs and push a short summary to the thread.

bench-bot: Artifacts archived: /artifacts/coaxia-a1/2473214567 (perf_seq256.csv, perf_seq1024.csv, meta_logs.tar.gz, bios_dump.txt). :white_check_mark:

alex: Great, thanks all. Jin — please ping here when uploads complete and we'll schedule a 30m sync to review initial numbers.

jin (Coaxia): Will do. Pinged for Tue slot. Thanks!
